title: RS-290 and RS-291 (Facebook session bugs, RS-291 is P1) sit in backlog although both shipped in facebook-tracker 0.10.4-0.10.6
failure_scenario: An agent asked to pick up open Facebook work lists backlog tickets (`scripts/ticket.sh list --status backlog`) and finds a P1 'saved login survives any restart'. RS-291's unchecked-looking live acceptance step is 'a logged-in worker restarted with docker restart ... comes back logged in' and RS-290's open box is a live login over Watch; re-verifying a shipped fix that way is exactly the worker restart / login the root AGENTS.md first rule forbids, risking a checkpointed account.
